Goal: a repeated message is marked once, and a failed check never marks a clean message.
Problem (rule): the lane split checking from marking so a failure leaves every line unmarked; no ruling covers this.
Based on (read): main marks each message inside the check step.
Departs from: main marks while checking — the change checks all first, then marks.

options.gain: After a failed check, no repeated message is skipped and no clean message is flagged.
options.how: The checker gets all answers, then marks the repeats in one pass.

options.gain: Each stop runs a little faster.
options.how: The checker marks each message as it checks it.
options.label: One step, as main does
